title: Pump with dry-run (low-level) protection
nl_spec: A pump runs on Demand, but must never run when the supply level is too low (LowLevel = TRUE) to avoid dry-running and damaging the pump. The low-level condition is a hard override. The pump is not latching; it follows demand each scan when it is safe to run. Write an IEC 61131-3 Structured Text PROGRAM named pump_ctrl with inputs Demand, LowLevel and output Pump.

safety_properties.nl: The pump never runs when the level is too low (dry-run protection).
The pump only runs on demand.

scenarios.description: Runs on demand when wet; off when dry

notes: Combinational safety override; companion to E06 heater over-temp.
